title: 自动记账报错：sun.org.mozilla.javascript.internal.WrappedException: Wrapped java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused: connect (<Unknown source>#192) in <Unknown source> at line number 192
problem: 自动记账报错：sun.org.mozilla.javascript.internal.WrappedException: Wrapped java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused: connect (<Unknown source>#192) in <Unknown source> at line number 192
solution:
修改artery.properties里配置localHost参数，对应时空服务地址端口
localHost=http://127.0.0.1:8080
